default_volume.label: Default volume
default_volume.description: Volume for mpv playback, 0-100. Used on play and until the widget, panel or launcher changes it.

search_limit.label: Search results
search_limit.description: How many stations to fetch per search or top list, 5-50.

country.label: Country filter
country.description: Optional country name to limit top lists and searches, e.g. Germany. Empty means worldwide.

mpv_bin.label: mpv binary
mpv_bin.description: mpv executable used for headless playback. Change only if mpv is not on PATH.

max_length.label: Station name length
max_length.description: Maximum characters of the station name shown in the bar, 5-60.
